title: BroadcastCommand
description: Request body for the simulator's HTTP control API. The simulator is a broadcaster: it publishes the loaded match once, in order, and never seeks. Viewers rewind and seek on their side (see ViewerCommand).

command.title: BroadcastCommandType
command.description: `load_match` replaces the broadcast with a match, ready to kick off; `play` and `pause` start and hold the broadcast; `set_speed` sets how fast match time passes.

speed.description: Broadcast speed multiplier. Required for set_speed.
